snippet.title: They Speak From The Abyss: Zenith - Official Demo Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Don't miss the Demo Trailer for They Speak From The Abyss: Zenith, a dungeon crawling retro RPG developed by Kalpasoft. Players will fight in turn-based combat through a suite of settings filled with despair and tragedy to reach the Zenith point. Resist or make peace with the demonic entities in They Speak From The Abyss: Zenith, coming soon to PC (Steam) with a new demo available now on Steam.
